Dattatreya Subramanya Vellal (Datta)
Software Excellence Competency Lead
Leader with over 18 years of experience leading global teams, delivering $3M+ in cost savings, and driving business impact in digital transformation, engineering excellence and executive influence across healthcare and e-commerce industries.
Rochester, Michigan | www.dsvellal.com | dsvellal@gmail.com | +1 248-933-2032 | LinkedIn: dattatreyavellal

=== RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE ===

Philips North America LLC, Rochester Hills, Michigan
Software Competency Lead | 11/2021 – Present
- Directed digital transformation and automation initiatives, leading U.S. teams to achieve $300K in infrastructure savings.
- Oversee medical device software audit readiness, authorizing complex software architectures to ensure compliance with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and ISO 14971.
- Orchestrated continuous value delivery strategy, slashing product delivery time by 60% and enhancing hospital outcomes.
- Pioneered adoption of digital platforms and Service-Ops automation, boosting productivity for 7,000+ Philips engineers worldwide with 99.999% uptime.
- Synthesized complex global software development metrics to author the 2024 State of Craftsmanship report, surfacing critical patterns and delivering high-impact insights to elevate software delivery speed and software quality.
- Mentored executive leaders in Software Development & Delivery, Technical Debt assessment & elimination realizing cost savings.

Philips India Limited, Bangalore, India
Software Competency Lead | 09/2018 – 11/2021
- Collaborated with business stakeholders to architect a 3-year digital transformation roadmap, delivering $2.3M in savings and unlocking $3.8M in future opportunities.
- Championed quality-at-desk program, leading cross-business teams to eliminate technical debt and secure $100K annual savings.
- Assembled and led a team of 8 to deploy CI/CD pipeline, slashing release cycles by 30% and elevating software quality.
- Partnered with C-level executives to overhaul Philips India hiring strategy, driving 18% candidate NPS and 15% manager NPS gains.
- Earned promotion to Principal (youngest in Philips India) by spearheading cost savings and delivery enhancements, showcasing executive-level impact.

Amazon India Private Limited, Bangalore, India
Software Development Engineer | 02/2016 – 08/2018
- Guided a team of 5 engineers to scale 6 microservices, powering 8M daily transactions with robust performance.
- Spearheaded infrastructure optimization using performance benchmarking, driving $34K in annual savings.
- Instituted agile practices and daily management policies, leading teams to reduce release time by 18%.
- Led scrum and agile ownership workshops for 150+ participants, earning a 4.3/5 satisfaction score and fostering team excellence.

=== PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE ===
Senior Lead Software Development, Exeter Software India Pvt Ltd | 04/2013 – 11/2015
Software Engineer, IBM India Private Limited | 07/2007 – 03/2013

=== SKILLS ===
- Cloud-Native Development – serverless, cloud architecture, AWS, Azure, CI/CD
- Security & Compliance – DevSecOps, zero-trust security
- Scalable System Architecture – Distributed systems, high-volume workload design
- AI & Machine Learning – AI-powered testing, automation, data-driven insights
- Legacy to Modern Software – Technical Debt Elimination, monoliths to microservices, refactoring, cloud adoption
- Medical Device Software Compliance – IEC 62304, ISO 14971, ISO 13485
- Program Management – Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Road mapping, Risk Management
- Stakeholder Management – Executive-level Reporting, Executive Presentations, Cross-functional leadership

=== EDUCATION ===
R.V. College of Engineering | Bachelor of Engineering, Computer Science | Bangalore, Karnataka, India | 07/2003 – 06/2007

=== OTHER ===
- Smart Home Automation Enthusiast.
- Deployed Language Model to reduce cognitive load of coaches in Math Pentathlon.
- Recipient of the prestigious Outstanding Achievement Award among others.
- Internationally certified to practice Yoga and Yoga Therapy.
- Many invited lectures, seminars & workshops globally, addressing over 2K participants from 22 institutions.
- Secured 2 Patents, driving engineering innovation.
- Mentored 30+ engineers to senior tech leadership role.
